pages.name: Jacob / Esau ("My Brother, My Enemy, Myself")

text.content: A @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} elder Embraced in the 8th century after enslavement in the Islamic world, Jacob holds the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} seat on the Council of Milwaukee and suffers from a split personality he created himself shortly after his Embrace: Jacob, a distinguished, fatherly conniver, and Esau, a hairier, more feral and paranoid persona who believes ancient heretics orchestrate all the world's evils. The two personalities have warred against each other for centuries through unwitting pawns among Milwaukee's Kindred, each side always somehow aware of the other's moves; any Kindred who becomes directly entangled in the Jacob/Esau war tends to die quickly. Jacob keeps a mansion in Greendale at the edge of Kindred territory and an expensive downtown condo as Esau. His extra level of Auspex manifests as "Insight of the Mad," an intuitive read on those around him that feeds his sixth level of Presence, "Coax" — a subtle compulsion that brings a target's own desires to the surface and makes it very difficult to resist doing what Jacob suggests.

Akawa's brash, none-too-bright childe and a full member of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.antitribu.JournalEntry.hs33xrNXWT2UXXS4]{Blood Brothers}, Wrecker (born Lewis) is a former street ganger Embraced 30 years ago for his usefulness as muscle rather than his intellect. Loud, reckless, and none too respected even within his own gang, Wrecker nonetheless enjoys Akawa's protection in exchange for the muscle he provides in desperate moments.

A @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.SNuXttNqxzJ6uPXv]{Caitiff} who clawed his way up from homelessness and gang life to lead the Union, Milwaukee's second-largest Anarch gang, Turk was Embraced in 1975 by Gengis, a Chicago Anarch of some standing who abandoned him immediately afterward as an unwanted @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.SNuXttNqxzJ6uPXv]{Caitiff} childe. Turk has since committed diablerie on a rival gang leader to strengthen his blood, and lives aboard a boat moored in McKinley Veterans Park. Unbeknownst to Turk, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} Esau has been secretly Dominating him for months, feeding his paranoia that all of Milwaukee's Kindred are conspiring against him as part of Esau's private war against his other self, Jacob. Gengis, though he abandoned Turk, would return to Milwaukee instantly if his childe were seriously threatened, having been unexpectedly moved by a single night of shared blood with him years later.

Embraced as a teenager in 1971 by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} Wendy (who was taken, presumably destroyed, by the Lupine soon after), Thomas Gerhieren was rescued from a suicidal frenzy against the Lupine by Mark Decker and has served in the Anubi ever since, now one of its oldest surviving members. Quiet, watchful, and prematurely aged in manner despite his boyish 16-year-old appearance, Thomas is Decker's most trusted lieutenant and heir apparent should Decker fall. He carries a silver-loaded Ruger 10/22 on Lupine patrols and keeps a haven of convenience among sympathetic teenage girls from wealthy, frequently-absent Outlands families.

A homeless-raised contract killer Embraced by Mark Decker after she spent a month failed-stalking him as a paid assassination target, Julia Calvin fell deeply, genuinely in love with her sire-captor during the week he kept her chained and fed from her before the final exchange of blood. She now fights at Decker's side in the Anubi, forced by him to keep their relationship private lest it become a liability in the war against the Lupine.

A @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} driven mad by drug use even before his accidental Embrace, Milo was banished from Chicago after his sire was executed for the crime of Embracing him, and fled to Milwaukee believing himself pursued by a malevolent entity he encountered in a lakeside drainpipe. Whether the horror hunting Milo is a delusion, a Wraith, an Umbral entity, or something worse is left to the Storyteller; Milo is convinced it will eventually kill him and then begin picking off Milwaukee's Kindred one by one.

Referenced by Jacob as his own sire from centuries of slavery in the Islamic world, Abd ar-Rahman is invoked, alongside Esau, in Jacob's fractured internal mythology of betrayal and power; he does not appear directly in the text beyond this framing, but Storytellers running Jacob's backstory may wish to develop him further.

A car-theft-ring boss recruited by Parovich for his streetwise toughness, Raul serves the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} elder as muscle and go-between in his dealings outside Kindred society, straddling the line between ghoul, blood doll, and reluctant conspirator in Parovich's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} schemes.

Once a popular, beautiful teenager left disfigured after a car accident that killed her parents, Anastasia was Embraced by Parovich as a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} — a cruel irony she has never accepted, still dressing in her old high-school clothes and speaking wistfully of how pretty she used to be. Warned by her fellow childe Kristian that Parovich works for the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s Black Hand and that they would all be Blood Bound if caught, Anastasia fled into hiding in the sewers and steam tunnels beneath her old school, her only companions a colony of stray cats and Kristian's weekly visits.

A juvenile-hall inmate who killed his abusive father with a baseball bat before Parovich Embraced him mid-sentence, Kristian used his Council contacts and eavesdropping to discover his sire's secret @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} allegiance, then led his fellow childer — including Anastasia — into hiding rather than be handed over for Blood Binding. Two of the fugitive childer have already been found and killed by Parovich; Kristian, protective and overconfident, is known to and occasionally favor-trades with both Edward Scott and other Anarch contacts, though he is reluctant to reveal what he knows about Parovich for fear of the consequences.

A @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} Embraced in 1934 Louisiana for his storytelling voice, Barth (radio persona "Derik Dark") is Milwaukee's only self-declared neutral party in the Elder/Anarch conflict, using his popular late-night radio show to broadcast coded messages, party announcements, and disguised Kindred news to listeners on both sides of the city's Kindred divide. He carefully avoids taking sides to keep his unique position safe, though Elders periodically pressure him to stop the coded broadcasts.

A French sculptor-aristocrat rescued from the guillotine and Embraced by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} elder Natasha, Louis Detonas fled Revolutionary France and eventually settled in Milwaukee, where he has appointed himself guardian of the city's art and culture against Anarch vandalism, working closely with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} elder Lucina (leader of Milwaukee's Toreador) to protect museums and concert halls.

A powerful @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} elder considered by Sir Edward Scott one of the least troublesome candidates for the vacant Princedom, Carna is tied to the magical anomaly (a mysterious "null zone") that has drawn both the attention of powerful @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} elders and the Werewolves to Milwaukee. She commands significant respect among the city's Kindred as a stabilizing, relatively uncontroversial potential ruler.

A named mortal or Kindred killer operating in Milwaukee's shadow economy of contract violence, Victor represents the more mundane, human alternative to hiring the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} Badr-al-Budur when Kindred factions need deniable killings performed without the complications of Clan politics.

A 9th-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} assassin descended from Fatimah, the legendary foremother who broke her Clan's ban on female initiates by earning the Embrace through the assassination of an ancient African @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue}, Badr-al-Budur travels the North American continent taking contracts from Elders and Anarchs alike, always returning to Milwaukee's endless internal wars as steady, lucrative work. She is a committed advocate for women's full standing within Clan @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite}, still resented by traditionalists who would prefer women confined to the Clan's herds. Hiring her carries real risk: she demands payment in the blood of Kindred of the 9th generation or older, refuses second attempts if she fails a contract, and retains dangerous personal knowledge of any employer she has worked for.

pages.name: Dr. Mortius / Mesita's Childe (the "Null Zone" Researcher)

text.content: A @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} occultist Embraced for a mortal magical discovery that impressed even the Clan's elders, this unnamed researcher (sired by Mesita) has been assigned to study Milwaukee's "null zone" — a magical anomaly whose secrets he believes may unlock realities beyond ordinary Kindred comprehension, and whose presence has drawn both @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} elder attention and increased Werewolf activity to the city.

vtmlarp.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred
